comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks gripper hardware; PR-1554 sends a loaded tote down a roller conveyor at a safe speed.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coupled torque control and tool withdrawal; PR-1554 requires impulse/release-speed regulation so the tote reaches a remote station without destabilizing its load.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained opening and lock integrity; PR-1554 grades final tote position after release with no bottle tip, spill, lift, or conveyor departure.
comparison.reason: PR-1554 tests dynamic launch control, not mechanical adjustment or locking.
